subject: Notice: Transition and offboarding — Laura Bennett
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: Transition and offboarding — Laura Bennett

Hi Grace and Jonas,

I wanted to let you both know that I have decided to resign from Redwood Inference. My last day will be Friday, July 29th (two weeks). This was a difficult decision but one I need to make for personal reasons.

I'll do my best to wrap up my active items and I can run a 1:1 handoff with Jonas next week to walk through the GTM integration and outstanding bugs. I attached my formal resignation letter for HR.

Practical notes: I have my company laptop (Asset TAG: RW-4832), a work phone, and a couple of external drives with personal files I need to remove before July 29. Please let me know the process for equipment return and whether any paperwork is needed for benefits/COBRA.

Thanks for the support over the years — I want this transition to be smooth.

Best,
Laura
Senior Product Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: resignation_letter_LB_2026-07-15.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Transition and offboarding — Laura Bennett

Hi Laura — thank you for letting us know and for the attached letter. I'm sorry to hear you're leaving but we appreciate the heads up.

Next steps from HR:
- I'll schedule an exit interview during your final week (opt-in).
- We need to confirm severance eligibility and any equity/vesting questions; I'm looped into Payroll and CompOps for verification.
- Please complete the asset inventory (see template) and let us know preferred pickup/return dates — IT typically coordinates a pickup within 5 business days of the last day unless you drop off.

Jonas, can you confirm which repos and shared drives Laura needs continued access to during the notice period? Separately, flag any accounts that should be restricted before final day (we often do staged access revocation on the last day for sensitive systems).

Laura — I'm going to draft a standard severance/termination checklist and send it privately later today. If you prefer to talk over the phone, I'm available after 2pm PT.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
People Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Transition and offboarding — Laura Bennett

Thanks for the note, Laura — sad to see you go.

Quick operational items from Eng:
- Please drop a short doc (1-2 pages) listing the current state of GTM-integration sprint items and the two highest-risk bugs you were triaging. I'll set a 60-min Handoff meeting for Monday, July 19.
- Repos: main repo (inference-gateway), deployment runbooks in /docs/oncall, and the private partner folder on Drive.
- Security flag: Laura has been working on an NDA partner integration (Partner: BrightPay). I recommend we remove code review approval rights on July 29 and revoke external API keys at EOD on the same day. Grace — please liaise with IT about staged access revocation.

Asset note: Asset tag RW-4832 will need pickup. I'll confirm whether we need a full disk image for legal; if so, we should coordinate with Legal.

Jonas
Engineering Manager
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft: Severance proposal and next steps

Hi Laura — following up with a draft severance proposal for your review. This is a standard form adjusted for tenure and role. Key points in the draft (attached):
- Two weeks' base salary in lieu of notice (to align with your stated last day)
- Continuation of health benefits through August 31 (COBRA details attached)
- Mutual release standard clause and a reference letter option
- A brief non-compete carve-out for existing partner work for 90 days; full details in section 5

If the terms look broadly acceptable, I will send the final agreement via DocuSign and route to Payroll for final calculations. If you would like legal counsel to review, you're welcome to do so — we can extend the signing window to accommodate that.

Separately, I've attached an equipment inventory we started — please fill in the missing serial numbers and confirm pickup date. I'll coordinate with our vendor (Emily at Asset Recovery) for the physical pickup.

Attachment: severance_proposal_v1_2026-07-16.pdf; asset_inventory_LB.csv

On privacy: anything you share in the exit interview is confidential and used to improve our processes.

Best,
Grace
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 09:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Severance proposal and next steps

Hi Grace — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the draft. A few quick questions:
- Will the two weeks' pay cover unused PTO or is that separate?
- My RSU vesting schedule shows a small tranche on 2026-08-01. Will that vest if I leave on July 29?
- For the non-compete clause: could we limit the geography and shorten to 30 days? I'm primarily concerned about the BrightPay partner integration work.

For equipment pickup, the 2nd or 3rd of August would work best for me (I have travel July 30–31). I updated the asset inventory with the missing serials.

Appreciate you handling this.

—Laura
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 Jul 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Severance agreement & logistics

Laura — thanks for the clarifying questions. I've confirmed the following with Payroll and CompOps:
- PTO payout: unused accrued PTO will be paid out in the final paycheck per state law and company policy.
- RSU vesting: the tranche scheduled for 2026-08-01 is *not* eligible if your termination date is July 29; I flagged this with CompOps but the policy requires vesting on the grant date while employed.
- Non-compete: we can agree to narrow the clause to 30 days and limit it to avoiding actively soliciting Redwood's named enterprise partners; I'll reflect that change in v2.

Next steps:
1) I'm sending the revised agreement through DocuSign (link below). Please review and sign by EOD July 21 to ensure timely payroll processing.
2) Asset pickup: I've asked Emily at Asset Recovery to schedule pickup for Mon/Tue Aug 2–3. Contact: Emily Lewis <emily.lewis@assetrecovery.example.com>.
3) IT staging: Jonas, please confirm which systems need staged revocation; IT will suspend access at EOD on July 29 unless otherwise instructed.

DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/SevAgreement/12345
HubSpot ticket: HUBSPOT:TICKET-48291

If anything changes, let me know. Wishing you the best, Laura.

Grace O'Connor
People Operations Manager
Attachment: docusign_sev_link.txt
